episodes.title: How I lost my Cousin to the MAGA Cult
episodes.description:
My cousin became MAGA, and her transformation says a lot about the hypocrisy I see within white evangelical Christianity.

She checks every box on the Christian checklist. She goes to church, prays, wears crosses, memorizes Scripture, and publicly identifies as a Christian. At one point, she was even voting for Kentucky Democrat Andy Beshear.

Then came Charlie Kirk.

After the incident involving Kirk, she was furious that I dared to share his own words about accepting gun deaths as the cost of protecting the Second Amendment.

But here's what I find so disturbing.

Where was that outrage over Donald Trump's conduct? The lies? The infidelity? The sexual misconduct allegations and civil verdict? The felony convictions? January 6? The cruelty toward vulnerable people?

Through all of it, I never heard a word of condemnation from her.

But quoting Charlie Kirk? Apparently, THAT crossed the line.

This is the contradiction I want to discuss. How can someone claim to follow the teachings of Jesus while excusing behavior that appears to contradict those very teachings?

My position is simple: **Your values aren't defined by the cross around your neck, the church you attend, or how many Bible verses you memorize. They're revealed by what you're willing to defend, excuse, and accept.**

And I believe our political choices carry moral responsibility.

This isn't just about my cousin. It's about faith, accountability, political loyalty, and the difference between professing Christian values and actually living them.

#MAGA #ChristianNationalism #EvangelicalChristianity #Trump #CharlieKirk #PaulForEquality
